description: Converts a National Drug Code between FDA 10-digit layouts (4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1) and the HIPAA 11-digit 5-4-2 form, dashed or undashed. Ambiguous undashed 10-digit input is resolved against RxNav by checking all three possible layouts. Returns ndc11, ndc11_dashed, ndc10, product_ndc, segment_format, resolution method, candidate layouts, and RxNav status (ACTIVE, OBSOLETE, ALIEN, UNKNOWN) with RxCUI and concept name. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.
name: rx_ndc_convert
title: NDC format converter (10 to 11 digit)
